reasons.plausibility: The proposed precipitation hardening concept is scientifically sound for this alloy system, though there may be minor uncertainties regarding the exact formation and stability of Cu-rich phases under those conditions.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis can be decisively tested by comparing microstructural and wear data from the pre-annealed coating against the as-deposited baseline under identical high-temperature sliding conditions.
reasons.usefulness: It directly addresses how to enhance wear resistance at elevated temperatures via a clear processing modification and provides a straightforward experiment to validate and optimize the approach.
